title: Shrimpy's Guide to Standing Taller
mascot_sheet: Character model sheet of Shrimpy, a cute cartoon shrimp with an orange-pink shell, large expressive anime-style eyes, tiny black noodle limbs, and two curved antennae on his head. Clean 2D vector cartoon style, bold black outlines, flat vibrant colors, isolated on a plain white background, showing a full-body upright standing pose.
voice: Fast, punchy, energetic delivery with an upbeat humorous tone
music: Bouncy comedic cartoon instrumental with plucky pizzicato strings and bass at 125 BPM

scenes.vo: Tired of being curved like a shrimp?
scenes.bg: Vibrant solid yellow background with subtle cartoon speed lines radiating outwards
scenes.pose: Shrimpy hunched over in an extreme C-shape, desperately staring at a glowing smartphone with wide panicked eyes

props.prompt: Cartoon cracked smartphone emitting blue light with glowing alert icons

scenes.vo: First, fix that gamer slouch with simple stretches.
scenes.bg: Warm pastel orange gradient background with playful floating curved arrows
scenes.pose: Shrimpy enthusiastically arching his upper back backward, arms reaching high overhead with a determined smile

scenes.vo: Hang from a pull-up bar every day.
scenes.bg: Light cyan indoor gym background with minimal geometric wall patterns
scenes.pose: Shrimpy dangling comically from a pull-up bar by his little claws, eyes squeezed shut in effort as his body elongates slightly

props.prompt: Sturdy metal cartoon pull-up bar mounted horizontally

scenes.vo: Eat nutrient-rich meals and sleep eight full hours.
scenes.bg: Soft teal background split diagonally with light golden yellow accents
scenes.pose: Shrimpy happily resting his head on a fluffy cloud pillow while nibbling a leafy green broccoli floret

props.prompt: A tall glass of milk and fresh leafy green vegetables on a white plate
Cartoon crescent moon surrounded by sleepy 'Zzz' floating symbols

scenes.vo: Forget wacky internet contraptions; they do nothing!
scenes.bg: Flat lavender background with a faint comical question mark pattern
scenes.pose: Shrimpy strapped into a ridiculous medieval stretching torture rack, screaming with spiraling dizzy eyes

props.prompt: Absurd cartoon wooden stretching contraption with giant squeaky gears and leather straps

scenes.vo: Good posture reveals your true natural height!
scenes.bg: Bright sunny yellow backdrop with explosive comic book burst rays
scenes.pose: Shrimpy standing proudly straight, chest puffed out, hands on hips with a confident wink, casting a tall heroic shadow

props.prompt: Cartoon wooden height ruler measurement chart with bright red marker notches

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.
scenes.bg: Clean dynamic royal blue gradient background with subtle glowing dots
scenes.pose: Shrimpy standing upright, cheerfully pointing a thumb toward an app screen with a beaming smile

props.prompt: Modern sleek smartphone displaying the TallPlan app interface with daily growth goals and streak calendar
